pageProps.title: Ca Fe In Melbourne
pageProps.review: The very first cafe I visited upon arriving in Australia. It ended up being the best coffee of my entire trip, and the owner's charming nerdy personality left a wonderfully warm first impression of Australia.
pageProps.content: ## Review It was the first cafe I visited right after arriving in Australia. It was my first coffee on unfamiliar Melbourne soil, and it turned out to be the best coffee of my entire trip — perfectly suited to my taste. The ```nerdy charm``` of the owner who took my order was surprisingly right up my alley. Seeing the ```periodic table T-shirt``` the owner was wearing and the cafe name — a combination of chemical element symbols (Ca, Fe, In) — I was convinced he had an engineering background. He was friendly yet clearly took great pride in his coffee. Thanks to him, my very first impression of Australia remained a warm and wonderful memory. ## Pictures
